entries.8e79a22877f419ce: WASHINGTON HOTEL CORPORATION is a hotel operator that directly operates 43 hotels nationwide under two brands, "Washington Hotel Plaza" and "Washington R&B Hotel".
entries.ad7a031e1bca0107: This is a single segment of the hotel business. Under the two brands Washington Hotel Plaza and Washington R&B Hotel, it directly operates 43 hotels nationwide with a total of 9,435 guest rooms as of March 31, 2026. Revenue by business division for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,174 million for the Washington R&B Hotel Business, ¥11,817 million for the Washington Hotel Plaza Business, and ¥200 million for other.
